scope: Theorem 8.7 (Periodic prefix-box realization) of the manuscript “Incompressible Box Transport and Finite Computation” (preprints/Incompressible-Box-Transport-and-Finite-Computation-October-6-2026/manuscript.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 376 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2505dc09d3f2c24b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 30. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every deterministic machine and finite input, a compactly supported smooth force on R3, periodic with period one from time zero, realizes the fixed-origin halting event ∃t ≥ 0 : X(t; 0) ∈ (−4, −1) × (−1, 2) × (−1, 1) ⇐⇒ halting. The force has bounded mixed derivatives and the unique zero-data solution in the class of Proposi- tion 3.2. Its finite program uses full volume-preserving boxes; no solenoidal condition is imposed on the force itself.
